text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. We need clear owners + short deadlines for remediation: quota backstop, scheduler knobs, headroom runbook. Keep updates brief here and on the board.

akash: I can own scheduler tuning (A-sched). Plan: 48h spike analysis, then propose default changes for preemption/backfill. Draft PR target: 2025-06-03.

sam (oncall): Please include a short smoke test we can run during a surge simulation. I can run a simulated surge Wednesday evening.

natalie: I'll take quota backstop (A-quota). Will draft RB to add soft quotas for burst pools + hard fallback to reserved pool. Draft card by 2025-05-30 and request product-infra review.

leo: I'll write the headroom playbook (A-headroom): steps to increase capacity, contact list, and an automated alert at 10% headroom. Draft by 2025-05-28.

maria: Good. Can we also make this a short recurring check for 6 weeks to catch regressions? Wednesdays 10:00 PT works for me.

akash: Works. I'll also run a 3-night autoscaler dry-run in staging and post logs to the board. Command: `./tools/autoscale-sim --policy=prod-sim --duration=3h --output=logs/autosim-$(date +%s).tgz`

natalie: Linking the triage board: https://redwood.internal/boards/gpu-capacity. A-quota card created and tagged @infra.

leo: Headroom alert snippet I'll add to monitoring:

```
apiVersion: monitoring/v1
kind: Alert
metadata:
  name: gpu_headroom_warning
spec:
  expr: (sum(gpu_free_seconds) / sum(gpu_total_seconds)) < 0.10
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-headroom
```

sam (oncall): Nice. ops-bot, please create a recurring calendar event and add the owners.

ops-bot: Created event "GPU capacity remediation check" weekly on Wednesdays 10:00 PT. Invites sent to maria, akash, natalie, leo, sam (oncall). Event link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/9981

maria: Owners and deadlines summary: A-sched: akash  2025-06-03; A-quota: natalie  2025-05-30; A-headroom: leo  2025-05-28. Add short test plans to the board.

akash: Posted PR #1187 with benchmark results, requesting review. I'll add the smoke test script and instructions for sam.

natalie: Quota runbook draft is up on the board. @product-infra please review by 2025-05-29 so we can iterate before enforcement.

leo: Headroom runbook published and alert enabled. Monitoring will notify the sync channel on threshold breach.

sam (oncall): I'll validate the scheduler changes and fallback ladder during the simulated surge on 2025-06-05 evening. Plan: verify preemption behavior, autoscaler response, and graceful fallback to smaller model variants if needed.

maria: One more note: codify a fallback ladder in the runbook: quantized model -> smaller variant -> temporary rate-limit. Only use as last resort.

(narrow follow-up, 2025-05-26) akash: PR moved to review with perf charts and suggested defaults.

(narrow follow-up, 2025-05-27) natalie: quota mapping posted; waiting on infra/product feedback.

(narrow follow-up, 2025-05-28) leo: alert firing tested in staging; will monitor overnight and report at Wed sync.

(ops-bot, 2025-06-02) reminder: next weekly remediation check in 48 hours.
